answer_1.quote: In this work, we fill this gap and evaluate, for the first time, (fine-tuned) automatic poetry generation systems in terms of their diversity.

answer_2.quote: we automatically measure diversity by comparing distributions of generated and existing poems along formal, semantic and stylistic dimensions.

answer_4.quote: we conducted a small-scale human evaluation of the overall quality of quatrains, focusing specifically on coherence and semantics
answer_4.guideline: an annotator was given 4 quatrains and asked to select both the best and the worst among them.
